# Aims of the study

The Monte Carlo experiments assess the finite-sample performance of the empirical, kernel-based and recursive
kernel-based estimators of the Bregman superquantile
$$SQ_p^\gamma(X)=(\gamma')^{-1}\!\Big(\tfrac{1}{1-p}\,\mathbb E\big[\gamma'(X)\mathbf 1_{\{X\ge Q_p\}}\big]\Big),\qquad Q_p=F^{-1}(p),$$
and confront them with the asymptotic theory of the revised article. The objectives are fourfold:

1. to assess the **finite-sample accuracy** of the empirical, kernel and recursive estimators;
2. to provide an **empirical validation of the asymptotic theory**: consistency, asymptotic normality
   (Kolmogorov distance to the Gaussian limit), asymptotic variances, bias expansions and bandwidth regimes,
   including the influence of the bandwidth and of the tail heaviness;
3. to illustrate the advantages of **recursive estimation** for large-scale and streaming data;
4. to evaluate Bregman superquantiles as **building blocks for robust parameter estimation** in heavy-tailed models
   (generalized Pareto and stable distributions).

**Estimators.**

| Code | Estimator | Remark |
|---|---|---|
| `emp` | empirical (Definition 2.1) | |
| `ker` | Gaussian-kernel estimator (Definition 2.2), $h_n=n^{-a}$, $a=$ `a_default` | bias $B'h_n^2$ |
| `rec_ind` | Robbins–Monro with **indicator** $W_{n+1}=\mathbf 1_{\{X_{n+1}\le Q_n\}}$, step $1/n$, Newton gains $\Lambda=\hat A^{-1}$ | reference of the bandwidth sweep |
| `rec_ker` | recursive **kernel** estimator, $W_{n+1}=H((Q_n-X_{n+1})/h_n)$, step $1/n$, Newton gains $\Lambda=\hat A^{-1}$ (Corollary 3.4) | sweep $a\in$ `a_rec`; variance $\sigma^2$ |
| `rec_pr` | recursive kernel estimator, step $n^{-\rho}$ (`rho_pr`, default 0.8) and **Polyak–Ruppert averaging** of the iterates | variance $\sigma^2$; no estimate of $A$ needed |
| `rec_ker04`, `rec_pr04` | the two recursive kernel estimators above with $h_n=n^{-0.4}$ (`a_rec_ref`) | stronger undersmoothing: smaller recursive bias |

Newton gains (or averaging) are needed to reach the batch variance $\sigma^2$ (Corollary 3.4); all recursive
estimators of this notebook therefore use one of these two devices.

**Design.** $\mathcal N(0,1)$, GPD$(0.3,1)$, GPD$(0.8,1)$ and $S_0(1.5,0,1,0)$; generators `quad`
($\gamma'(x)=x$, CVaR) and `asinh` ($\gamma'(x)=\operatorname{asinh}x$); $p\in\{0.25,0.50,0.75,0.95\}$;
$n=20\,000$ and $M=5\,000$ replications. All estimators of a replication use **the same sample** (common random numbers)
and all recursive estimators share **the same warm start**.

**Regimes.** *Regular* when $\mathrm{Var}(\gamma'(X))<\infty$ (the CLT applies: all distributions with `asinh`,
$\mathcal N(0,1)$ and GPD$(0.3)$ with `quad`); *non-regular* otherwise (GPD$(0.8)$ and the stable law with `quad`:
finite mean, infinite variance). Non-regular results are robustness checks, not validations of the CLT.

**Corrections with respect to earlier versions of the code.**
(i) $\sigma^2=\mathrm{Var}\big((\gamma'(X)-\gamma'(q_p))_+\big)/\{(1-p)^2\gamma''(SQ)^2\}$
(the former `sig2_hat`/`truth` used $\gamma'(X)\mathbf 1_{\{X\ge q\}}-\gamma'(q)\mathbf 1_{\{X\le q\}}$, wrong sign);
(ii) $B'=\mu_2\{\gamma''(q)f(q)+\int_q^\infty\gamma'''f\}/\{2(1-p)\gamma''(SQ)\}$, without the spurious term $-2\gamma'(q)f'(q)$;
(iii) $\Gamma_{12}=+p\,\theta_p$ in the Lyapunov equation (the former sign produced impossible efficiencies $>1$);
(iv) `params` is never modified (it is read-only in `rmarkdown`) and is recreated for interactive use;
(v) tail integrals never evaluate $Q(1)=\infty$ and fall back to looser tolerances instead of returning silent `NA`s
(the cause of the error `Faceting variables must have at least one value`); figures with no data are skipped with a message;
(vi) the bandwidth $h=\hat s\,n^{-1/5}$ ($a<1/4$) oversmooths; the reference kernel estimators use $a=0.3$.

# Configuration

```{r config}
#' Builds the configuration from the YAML parameters (params is never modified).
make_cfg <- function(pr) {
  num <- function(s) as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(s), ",")[[1]])
  cfg <- list(quick = isTRUE(pr$quick), cores = max(1L, as.integer(pr$cores)),
              n = as.integer(pr$n), M = as.integer(pr$M), block = as.integer(pr$block),
              p_levels = num(pr$p_levels), a_rec = sort(unique(num(pr$a_rec))),
              a_default = as.numeric(pr$a_default),
              a_rec_ref = if (is.null(pr$a_rec_ref)) 0.4 else as.numeric(pr$a_rec_ref),
              rho_pr = if (is.null(pr$rho_pr)) 0.8 else as.numeric(pr$rho_pr), h_scale = as.character(pr$h_scale),
              n_ks = sort(as.integer(num(pr$n_ks))), M_ks = as.integer(pr$M_ks),
              M_bw = as.integer(pr$M_bw), M_param = as.integer(pr$M_param), n_param = as.integer(pr$n_param),
              M_stable = as.integer(pr$M_stable), n_stable = as.integer(pr$n_stable),
              stable_alpha = num(pr$stable_alpha), stable_beta = num(pr$stable_beta),
              out = as.character(pr$out), seed = 20261109L)
  if (cfg$quick)
    cfg <- modifyList(cfg, list(n = 5000L, M = 200L, block = 100L, n_ks = c(250L, 1000L, 5000L), M_ks = 100L,
                                M_bw = 200L, M_param = 100L, n_param = 2000L, M_stable = 10L, n_stable = 2000L))
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") cfg$cores <- 1L
  if (!cfg$h_scale %in% c("none", "robust")) stop("h_scale must be 'none' or 'robust'.")
  cfg$a_rec <- sort(unique(c(cfg$a_rec, cfg$a_default, cfg$a_rec_ref)))
  cfg$a_pr <- unique(c(cfg$a_default, cfg$a_rec_ref))
  cfg$block <- min(cfg$block, cfg$M)
  cfg$M <- cfg$block * ceiling(cfg$M / cfg$block)
  n0_max <- n0_rule(max(cfg$p_levels))
  g <- unique(as.integer(round(cfg$n / c(16, 8, 4, 2, 1))))
  cfg$n_grid <- g[g >= 2 * n0_max]
  for (d in c("", "figures", "tables")) dir.create(file.path(cfg$out, d), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  cfg
}

#' Warm-start size: at least 20 expected observations beyond Q_p.
n0_rule <- function(p) as.integer(max(200, ceiling(20 / (1 - p))))

cfg <- make_cfg(params)
str(cfg[c("n", "M", "block", "n_grid", "p_levels", "a_rec", "a_default", "a_rec_ref", "h_scale", "n_ks", "M_ks", "cores")])
```

# Function library

## Bregman generators

`g1` $=\gamma'$, `g2` $=\gamma''$, `g3` $=\gamma'''$, `ginv` $=(\gamma')^{-1}$. The `asinh` generator has logarithmic
growth: $\gamma'(X)$ has moments of all orders, which restores the CLT regime for infinite-variance distributions.

```{r generators}
make_generator <- function(name, s = 1, a = 0.5) {
  switch(name,
    quad = list(name = "quad", label = "Quadratic (CVaR)", growth = "linear",
                g1 = function(x) x, g2 = function(x) rep(1, length(x)),
                g3 = function(x) rep(0, length(x)), ginv = function(y) y),
    asinh = list(name = "asinh", label = "asinh (Bregman)", growth = "log", s = s,
                 g1 = function(x) asinh(x / s),
                 g2 = function(x) 1 / (s * sqrt(1 + (x / s)^2)),
                 g3 = function(x) -(x / s) / (s^2 * (1 + (x / s)^2)^1.5),
                 ginv = function(y) s * sinh(y)),
    sin = list(name = "sin", label = "x + a cos x", growth = "linear", a = a,
               g1 = function(x) x + a * cos(x), g2 = function(x) 1 - a * sin(x),
               g3 = function(x) -a * cos(x),
               ginv = function(y) { x <- y; for (k in 1:60) x <- x - (x + a * cos(x) - y) / (1 - a * sin(x)); x }),
    stop("Unknown generator: ", name))
}
gens <- list(quad = make_generator("quad"), asinh = make_generator("asinh"))
gen_lab <- vapply(gens, `[[`, "", "label")
```

## Distributions and tail integrals

Each distribution provides `tail_int(fun, q)` $=\int_q^\infty \mathrm{fun}(x)f(x)\,dx$, computed without evaluating
$Q(1)=\infty$: exact change of variables for the GPD, density integration for the Gaussian law and, for the stable law,
integration of `dstable` on $[q,q+200\gamma]$ completed by the Pareto tail
$f(x)\sim\alpha\,C_\alpha(1+\beta)\gamma^\alpha x^{-\alpha-1}$, $C_\alpha=\Gamma(\alpha)\sin(\pi\alpha/2)/\pi$.
`excess(q)` $=\mathbb E[(X-q)^+]$ is exact (stable law: relation $H$ of Theorem 6.1).

```{r distributions}
gauss_legendre <- function(m) {
  i <- seq_len(m - 1); b <- i / sqrt(4 * i^2 - 1)
  J <- matrix(0, m, m); J[cbind(i, i + 1)] <- b; J[cbind(i + 1, i)] <- b
  e <- eigen(J, symmetric = TRUE); o <- order(e$values)
  list(x = e$values[o], w = 2 * e$vectors[1, o]^2)
}
gauss_laguerre <- function(m) {          # int_0^inf g(t) exp(-t) dt ~ sum w_j g(t_j)
  i <- seq_len(m); J <- diag(2 * i - 1); k <- seq_len(m - 1)
  J[cbind(k, k + 1)] <- k; J[cbind(k + 1, k)] <- k
  e <- eigen(J, symmetric = TRUE); o <- order(e$values)
  list(x = e$values[o], w = e$vectors[1, o]^2)
}
.GL20 <- gauss_legendre(20); .GL40 <- gauss_legendre(40); .GLag <- gauss_laguerre(64)

#' Nolan's integral g_{-1}(x | alpha, beta) = int_0^inf [cos(x r - beta tan(pi alpha/2) r^alpha) - 1] r^-2 exp(-r^alpha) dr
g_m1 <- function(x, alpha, beta) {
  tn <- tan(pi * alpha / 2); R <- 34^(1 / alpha)
  phase <- max(abs(x)) * R + abs(beta * tn) * R^alpha
  npan <- min(400, max(8, ceiling(phase / 12)))
  edges <- seq(0, R, length.out = npan + 1); a <- edges[-length(edges)]; b <- edges[-1]
  half <- (b - a) / 2; mid <- (a + b) / 2
  r <- as.vector(outer(.GL20$x, half) + matrix(mid, 20, npan, byrow = TRUE))
  w <- as.vector(outer(.GL20$w, half)); er <- exp(-r^alpha) / r^2; rA <- r^alpha
  vapply(x, function(xi) sum(w * (-2 * sin((xi * r - beta * tn * rA) / 2)^2) * er), numeric(1))
}

#' Theorem 6.1: E[(X - Q)^+] for X ~ S0(alpha, beta, gam, zeta), alpha > 1 (vectorised in Q).
H_stable <- function(Q, alpha, beta, gam = 1, zeta = 0) {
  tn <- tan(pi * alpha / 2); z <- (Q - zeta + beta * gam * tn) / gam
  0.5 * (zeta - beta * gam * tn - Q) + (gam / pi) * (base::gamma(1 - 1 / alpha) - g_m1(z, alpha, beta))
}

memo <- function(f) {
  cache <- new.env(hash = TRUE)
  function(u) vapply(u, function(v) {
    k <- sprintf("%.15g", v)
    if (!exists(k, envir = cache, inherits = FALSE)) assign(k, f(v), envir = cache)
    get(k, envir = cache)
  }, numeric(1))
}

#' Robust numerical integration: non-finite integrand values are set to 0 (they only occur at the
#' boundary point Q(1) = Inf, where the integrand vanishes) and the tolerance is relaxed progressively
#' instead of returning NA at the first warning of integrate().
safe_int <- function(f, lo, hi) {
  g <- function(x) { v <- f(x); v[!is.finite(v)] <- 0; v }
  for (tol in c(1e-10, 1e-8, 1e-6, 1e-4)) {
    r <- tryCatch(integrate(g, lo, hi, subdivisions = 5000L, rel.tol = tol, stop.on.error = FALSE),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(r) && is.finite(r$value) &&
        (identical(r$message, "OK") || r$abs.error <= 1e-6 * max(1, abs(r$value)))) return(r$value)
  }
  NA_real_
}

make_dist <- function(family, ...) {
  a <- list(...)
  if (family == "gauss") {
    list(id = "N(0,1)", family = family, tail_index = Inf, scale = 1,
         r = function(n) rnorm(n), q = qnorm, d = dnorm, p = pnorm,
         excess = function(q) dnorm(q) - q * pnorm(q, lower.tail = FALSE),
         tail_int = function(fun, q) safe_int(function(x) fun(x) * dnorm(x), q, Inf))
  } else if (family == "gpd") {
    xi <- a$xi; sg <- if (is.null(a$sigma)) 1 else a$sigma
    pf <- function(x) { x <- pmax(x, 0); 1 - (1 + xi * x / sg)^(-1 / xi) }
    list(id = sprintf("GPD(%g)", xi), family = family, xi = xi, sigma = sg,
         tail_index = 1 / xi, scale = sg,
         r = function(n) sg / xi * (runif(n)^(-xi) - 1),
         q = function(u) sg / xi * ((1 - u)^(-xi) - 1),
         d = function(x) ifelse(x < 0, 0, (1 / sg) * (1 + xi * pmax(x, 0) / sg)^(-1 / xi - 1)),
         p = pf,
         excess = function(q) (1 - pf(q)) * (sg + xi * q) / (1 - xi),        # xi < 1
         tail_int = function(fun, q) {                                       # v = P(X > x) = r e^{-t}
           r <- 1 - pf(q)
           safe_int(function(t) { v <- r * exp(-t); fun(sg / xi * (v^(-xi) - 1)) * v }, 0, Inf)
         })
  } else if (family == "stable") {
    al <- a$alpha; be <- if (is.null(a$beta)) 0 else a$beta
    ga <- if (is.null(a$gamma)) 1 else a$gamma; de <- if (is.null(a$zeta)) 0 else a$zeta
    dfun <- function(x) suppressWarnings(stabledist::dstable(x, alpha = al, beta = be, gamma = ga, delta = de, pm = 0))
    Kt <- (1 + be) * base::gamma(al) * sin(pi * al / 2) / pi * ga^al      # P(X > x) ~ Kt x^-alpha
    list(id = sprintf("Stable(%g,%g)", al, be), family = family, alpha = al, beta = be, gamma = ga, zeta = de,
         tail_index = if (al < 2) al else Inf, scale = ga,
         r = function(n) stabledist::rstable(n, alpha = al, beta = be, gamma = ga, delta = de, pm = 0),
         q = memo(function(u) stabledist::qstable(u, alpha = al, beta = be, gamma = ga, delta = de, pm = 0)),
         d = dfun,
         p = function(x) stabledist::pstable(x, alpha = al, beta = be, gamma = ga, delta = de, pm = 0),
         excess = function(q) H_stable(q, al, be, ga, de),
         tail_int = function(fun, q) {
           L1 <- max(q, de) + 10 * ga; L <- max(q, de) + 200 * ga
           safe_int(function(x) fun(x) * dfun(x), q, L1) + safe_int(function(x) fun(x) * dfun(x), L1, L) +
             safe_int(function(x) fun(x) * al * Kt * (x - de)^(-al - 1), L, Inf)
         })
  } else stop("Unknown family: ", family)
}

dists <- list(make_dist("gauss"), make_dist("gpd", xi = 0.3), make_dist("gpd", xi = 0.8),
              make_dist("stable", alpha = 1.5, beta = 0))
names(dists) <- vapply(dists, `[[`, "", "id")
file_id <- function(id) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9.]+", "_", id)
```

## Theoretical quantities (corrected formulas)

For $(F,\gamma,p)$, `truth()` returns $q=Q_p$, $\theta=\gamma'(SQ)$, $s=SQ_p^\gamma$ and

* $\sigma^2=\mathrm{Var}\big((\gamma'(X)-\gamma'(q))_+\big)/\{(1-p)^2\gamma''(s)^2\}$: asymptotic variance of the empirical and undersmoothed kernel estimators;
* $B'=\{\gamma''(q)f(q)+\int_q^\infty\gamma'''f\}/\{2(1-p)\gamma''(s)\}$: bias constant $B'h_n^2$ of the kernel estimator ($\mu_2=1$);
* $A=\begin{pmatrix} f(q)&0\\ \gamma'(q)f(q)/(1-p)&1\end{pmatrix}$, $\Gamma=\begin{pmatrix}p(1-p)&p\theta\\ p\theta&\mathbb E[\gamma'(X)^2\mathbf 1_{\{X>q\}}]/(1-p)^2-\theta^2\end{pmatrix}$;
* recursive variance $\Sigma_{22}/\gamma''(s)^2$, with $(\Lambda A-\tfrac I2)\Sigma+\Sigma(\Lambda A-\tfrac I2)^\top=\Lambda\Gamma\Lambda^\top$;
  for Newton gains $\Lambda=A^{-1}$ it equals $\sigma^2$ (checked below);
* **first-order bias of the recursive kernel estimator** (derived for this study): with $h_i=c\,i^{-a}$, $a<1/2$,
  $\mathbb E\,(Q_n-q,\ \theta_n-\theta)\approx-(\Lambda A-2aI)^{-1}\Lambda\beta\,c^2n^{-2a}$,
  $\beta=\big(f'(q)/2,\ \{\gamma''(q)f(q)+\gamma'(q)f'(q)\}/\{2(1-p)\}\big)$.

```{r truth}
lyap_solve <- function(Lambda, A, Gamma) {
  if (any(!is.finite(Gamma)) || any(!is.finite(A)) || any(!is.finite(Lambda))) return(matrix(NA_real_, 2, 2))
  Mx <- Lambda %*% A - diag(2) / 2
  if (any(Re(eigen(Mx, only.values = TRUE)$values) <= 0)) return(matrix(NA_real_, 2, 2))
  L <- kronecker(diag(2), Mx) + kronecker(Mx, diag(2))
  matrix(solve(L, as.vector(Lambda %*% Gamma %*% t(Lambda))), 2, 2)
}

.tcache <- new.env()
truth <- function(dist, gen, p) {
  key <- paste(dist$id, gen$name, format(p), sep = "|")
  if (exists(key, envir = .tcache, inherits = FALSE)) return(get(key, envir = .tcache))
  r <- 1 - p; q <- dist$q(p); f <- dist$d(q)
  e <- 1e-3 * max(1, abs(q)); fp <- (dist$d(q + e) - dist$d(q - e)) / (2 * e)
  gq <- gen$g1(q)
  theta <- if (gen$name == "quad") q + dist$excess(q) / r else dist$tail_int(gen$g1, q) / r
  s <- gen$ginv(theta); g2s <- gen$g2(s)
  applies <- (gen$growth == "log") || (dist$tail_index > 2)
  mc  <- r * (theta - gq)
  m2c <- if (applies) dist$tail_int(function(x) (gen$g1(x) - gq)^2, q) else Inf
  VT  <- (m2c - mc^2) / r^2
  I3 <- if (gen$name == "quad") 0 else dist$tail_int(gen$g3, q)
  Bprime <- (gen$g2(q) * f + I3) / (2 * r * g2s)
  A <- matrix(c(f, gq * f / r, 0, 1), 2, 2)
  m2 <- m2c + 2 * gq * mc + gq^2 * r
  Gam <- matrix(c(p * r, p * theta, p * theta, m2 / r^2 - theta^2), 2, 2)
  S_newt <- lyap_solve(solve(A), A, Gam)
  out <- list(dist = dist$id, gen = gen$name, p = p, q = q, f = f, fp = fp, theta = theta, s = s, g2s = g2s,
              applies = applies, VT = VT, sigma2 = if (applies) VT / g2s^2 else Inf, Bprime = Bprime,
              A = A, Gamma = Gam, beta_rec = c(fp / 2, (gen$g2(q) * f + gq * fp) / (2 * r)),
              var_rec_newton = if (applies) S_newt[2, 2] / g2s^2 else Inf,
              regime = if (applies) "regular (CLT)" else "non-regular (Var = Inf)")
  if (applies && !is.finite(out$sigma2)) warning("Non-finite asymptotic variance for ", key, ": check the tail integrals.")
  assign(key, out, envir = .tcache)
  out
}

rec_bias_theory <- function(tr, a, n, c = 1) {              # Newton gains Lambda = A^-1
  if (!is.finite(a) || a >= 0.5 || any(!is.finite(tr$beta_rec))) return(NA_real_)
  Lam <- solve(tr$A)
  K <- -solve(Lam %*% tr$A - 2 * a * diag(2), Lam %*% tr$beta_rec)
  K[2] * c^2 * n^(-2 * a) / tr$g2s
}
pop_scale <- function(dist, cfg) if (cfg$h_scale == "robust") (dist$q(0.75) - dist$q(0.25)) / 1.349 else 1

#' Theoretical standard deviation and bias of an estimator (method, a, n).
theory_for <- function(tr, method, a, n, c = 1) {
  sd_b <- sqrt(tr$sigma2 / n)
  switch(method,
    emp        = c(sd = sd_b, bias = 0),
    ker        = c(sd = sd_b, bias = tr$Bprime * (c * n^(-a))^2),
    rec_ind    = c(sd = sd_b, bias = 0),
    rec_ker    = c(sd = sd_b, bias = rec_bias_theory(tr, a, n, c)),
    rec_pr     = c(sd = sd_b, bias = NA_real_),
    c(sd = NA_real_, bias = NA_real_))
}
```

## Estimators

Batch estimators are **vectorised over the rows** of a matrix of samples (one row = one replication).
The recursive engine updates all variants (all $a$, indicator, Polyak–Ruppert) **in a single pass**, with Newton gains:
$$Q_{i}=Q_{i-1}-a_i\,\hat g_q\,(W_i-p),\qquad
\theta_{i}=\theta_{i-1}-a_i\Big[\theta_{i-1}-\tfrac{\gamma'(X_i)(1-W_i)}{1-p}-\tfrac{\gamma'(Q_{i-1})(W_i-p)}{1-p}\Big],$$
$a_i=1/i$ (`rec_ind`, `rec_ker`) or $a_i=i^{-\rho}$, $\rho=$ `rho_pr` $=0.8$, followed by the average $\bar\theta_n=\frac1{n-n_0}\sum_{i>n_0}\theta_i$ (`rec_pr`),
and $\hat g_q=1/\hat f(Q_{n_0})$ from an empirical warm start on $n_0$ observations.

```{r estimators}
robust_scale <- function(x) {
  s <- IQR(x) / 1.349
  if (!is.finite(s) || s <= 0) s <- sd(x)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s <= 0) s <- 1
  s
}
sort_rows <- function(X) { S <- t(apply(X, 1, sort)); if (nrow(X) == 1) S <- matrix(S, 1); S }
col_name <- function(method, a, n) paste(method, if (is.na(a)) "NA" else as.character(a), n, sep = "|")

est_emp_rows <- function(Xs, p, gen) {
  m <- ncol(Xs); r <- 1 - p; k <- ceiling(m * p - 1e-9)
  q <- Xs[, k]
  up <- if (k < m) rowSums(gen$g1(Xs[, (k + 1):m, drop = FALSE])) else 0
  Tn <- ((k - m * p) * gen$g1(q) + up) / (m * r)
  list(est = gen$ginv(Tn), q = q, T = Tn)
}

kernel_quantile <- function(x, p, h, start = NULL) {
  if (is.null(start)) start <- unname(quantile(x, p, type = 1))
  t <- start
  for (it in 1:30) {
    z <- (t - x) / h
    Fv <- mean(pnorm(z)) - p; dv <- mean(dnorm(z)) / h
    if (!is.finite(dv) || dv < 1e-12) break
    stp <- Fv / dv; t <- t - stp
    if (!is.finite(t)) break
    if (abs(stp) < 1e-10 * (1 + abs(t))) return(t)
  }
  tryCatch(uniroot(function(t) mean(pnorm((t - x) / h)) - p, range(x) + c(-8, 8) * h, tol = 1e-12)$root,
           error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

est_kernel <- function(x, p, gen, h, qh = NULL) {
  r <- 1 - p; n <- length(x)
  if (is.null(qh)) qh <- kernel_quantile(x, p, h)
  if (!is.finite(qh)) return(list(est = NA_real_, q = NA_real_, T = NA_real_))
  a <- (qh - x) / h
  if (gen$name == "quad") {
    Tn <- sum(x * pnorm(-a) + h * dnorm(a)) / (n * r)
  } else {
    far <- a < -8; band <- abs(a) <= 8
    s_far <- sum(gen$g1(x[far]) + h^2 / 2 * gen$g3(x[far]))
    ab <- a[band]; half <- (8 - ab) / 2; mid <- (8 + ab) / 2
    Z <- outer(half, .GL40$x) + mid
    vals <- gen$g1(x[band] + h * Z) * dnorm(Z)
    s_band <- sum(drop(vals %*% .GL40$w) * half)
    Tn <- (s_far + s_band) / (n * r)
  }
  list(est = gen$ginv(Tn), q = qh, T = Tn)
}

warm_start_rows <- function(X, p, gen, n0) {
  X0 <- X[, seq_len(n0), drop = FALSE]
  e0 <- est_emp_rows(sort_rows(X0), p, gen)
  s0 <- apply(X0, 1, robust_scale)
  hp <- s0 * n0^(-0.2)
  fq <- rowMeans(dnorm((e0$q - X0) / hp)) / hp
  fq <- pmax(fq, 0.1 * (1 - p) / s0)
  list(n0 = n0, Q = e0$q, T = e0$T, s0 = s0, gq = 1 / fq)
}

#' Vectorised recursive engine (replications x variants), Newton gains for every variant.
#' a_ker: bandwidth exponents of the step-1/i kernel recursions; a_pr: exponents of the
#' Polyak-Ruppert recursions (step i^-0.7, averaged iterates); ind: indicator recursion.
rec_engine <- function(X, GX, p, gen, ws, a_ker, a_pr = numeric(0), rec_at, h_scale = "none", ind = TRUE,
                       rho_pr = get0("cfg", ifnotfound = list(rho_pr = 0.8))$rho_pr) {
  B <- nrow(X); n <- ncol(X); r <- 1 - p
  avec <- c(a_ker, a_pr); rho <- c(rep(1, length(a_ker)), rep(rho_pr, length(a_pr)))
  Kk <- length(avec); idx_pr <- which(rho < 1); any_pr <- length(idx_pr) > 0
  cn <- c(paste0("rec_ker|", as.character(a_ker)),
          if (any_pr) paste0("rec_pr|", as.character(a_pr)), "rec_ind|NA")
  Qk <- matrix(ws$Q, B, Kk); Tk <- matrix(ws$T, B, Kk); Qi <- ws$Q; Ti <- ws$T; gq <- ws$gq
  Tbar <- Tk[, idx_pr, drop = FALSE]; nb_avg <- 0L
  Cvec <- if (h_scale == "robust") rep(ws$s0, Kk) else rep(1, B * Kk)
  rec_at <- sort(unique(rec_at[rec_at > ws$n0 & rec_at <= n]))
  outT <- outQ <- vector("list", length(rec_at)); j <- 1L
  for (i in (ws$n0 + 1L):n) {
    xi <- X[, i]; gi <- GX[, i]
    ak <- rep(i^(-rho), each = B)
    Wk <- pnorm((Qk - xi) / (Cvec * rep(i^(-avec), each = B)))
    dT <- Tk - gi * (1 - Wk) / r - gen$g1(Qk) * (Wk - p) / r
    Tk <- Tk - ak * dT
    Qk <- Qk - ak * gq * (Wk - p)
    if (any_pr) { nb_avg <- nb_avg + 1L; Tbar <- Tbar + (Tk[, idx_pr, drop = FALSE] - Tbar) / nb_avg }
    if (ind) {
      Wi <- as.numeric(xi <= Qi)
      Ti <- Ti - (Ti - gi * (1 - Wi) / r - gen$g1(Qi) * (Wi - p) / r) / i
      Qi <- Qi - gq * (Wi - p) / i
    }
    if (j <= length(rec_at) && i == rec_at[j]) {
      Tout <- Tk; if (any_pr) Tout[, idx_pr] <- Tbar
      outT[[j]] <- `colnames<-`(cbind(Tout, Ti), cn); outQ[[j]] <- `colnames<-`(cbind(Qk, Qi), cn)
      j <- j + 1L
    }
  }
  list(n = rec_at, T = outT, Q = outQ)
}

se_batch <- function(x, p, gen, q, s) {
  z <- pmax(gen$g1(x) - gen$g1(q), 0)
  sqrt(var(z) / (1 - p)^2 / gen$g2(s)^2 / length(x))
}
```

```{r utils}
par_map <- function(X, FUN, cores = 1) {
  res <- if (cores > 1) parallel::mclapply(X, FUN, mc.cores = cores, mc.preschedule = FALSE) else lapply(X, FUN)
  bad <- vapply(res, function(r) inherits(r, "try-error") || inherits(r, "error"), logical(1))
  if (any(bad)) stop("A parallel task failed: ", as.character(res[[which(bad)[1]]]))
  res
}
meth_lab <- c(emp = "Empirical (batch)", ker = "Kernel (batch)", rec_ind = "Recursive indicator (Newton gains)",
              rec_ker = sprintf("Recursive kernel (Newton gains), h = n^-%g", cfg$a_default),
              rec_ker04 = sprintf("Recursive kernel (Newton gains), h = n^-%g", cfg$a_rec_ref),
              rec_pr = sprintf("Recursive kernel, n^-%g + PR averaging, h = n^-%g", cfg$rho_pr, cfg$a_default),
              rec_pr04 = sprintf("Recursive kernel, n^-%g + PR averaging, h = n^-%g", cfg$rho_pr, cfg$a_rec_ref))
meth_col <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#009E73", "black", "#0072B2", "#56B4E9", "#CC79A7", "#E69F00"), meth_lab)
#' Reference-estimator key of a (method, a) column: rec_ker / rec_pr at a_default and a_rec_ref.
ref_key <- function(method, a) {
  near <- function(x, y) !is.na(x) & abs(x - y) < 1e-12
  out <- ifelse(method %in% c("emp", "ker", "rec_ind"), method, NA_character_)
  out[method == "rec_ker" & near(a, cfg$a_default)] <- "rec_ker"
  out[method == "rec_ker" & near(a, cfg$a_rec_ref)] <- "rec_ker04"
  out[method == "rec_pr" & near(a, cfg$a_default)] <- "rec_pr"
  out[method == "rec_pr" & near(a, cfg$a_rec_ref)] <- "rec_pr04"
  out
}
#' Inverse map: key -> (method, a).
key_method <- function(k) sub("04$", "", k)
key_a <- function(k) ifelse(k %in% c("emp", "rec_ind"), NA_real_, ifelse(grepl("04$", k), cfg$a_rec_ref, cfg$a_default))
theme_article <- function(base = 15)
  theme_bw(base_size = base) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.4, "cm"))
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 14, height = 8) {
  ggsave(file.path(cfg$out, "figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height,
         units = "in", limitsize = FALSE, device = if (capabilities("cairo")) cairo_pdf else "pdf")
  invisible(plot)
}
#' Prints and saves a ggplot only when its data are non-empty
#' (avoids "Faceting variables must have at least one value").
emit_plot <- function(plot, data, name, width = 14, height = 8) {
  if (is.null(data) || NROW(data) == 0) { message("No data for figure '", name, "': skipped."); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  print(plot); save_fig(plot, name, width, height)
}
latex_escape <- function(s) gsub("([_%&#$])", "\\\\\\1", s)
#' Writes a booktabs LaTeX table to out/tables/<name>.tex (label tab:<label>) and displays it.
save_latex <- function(df, name, caption, label = name, digits = 3) {
  tex <- knitr::kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, digits = digits, caption = latex_escape(caption),
                      label = label, linesep = "", row.names = FALSE)
  writeLines(tex, file.path(cfg$out, "tables", paste0(name, ".tex")))

}
pfile <- function(p) gsub("\\.", "_", sprintf("%.2f", p))
winsor_by <- function(v, g, probs = c(0.005, 0.995))
  ave(v, g, FUN = function(z) { qq <- quantile(z, probs, na.rm = TRUE); pmin(pmax(z, qq[1]), qq[2]) })
```

# Preliminary checks (exact formulas)

Each check is reported as `PASS`, `FAIL` or `NA`; a non-finite value is reported, never turned into an error.

```{r selfcheck}
selfcheck <- function() {
  chk <- list()
  add <- function(name, value, target, tol) {
    err <- abs(value - target) / max(abs(target), 1e-12)
    chk[[length(chk) + 1]] <<- data.frame(Check = name, Value = value, Target = target, `Relative error` = err,
      Tolerance = tol, Status = if (!is.finite(err)) "NA" else if (err <= tol) "PASS" else "FAIL", check.names = FALSE)
  }
  N <- dists[["N(0,1)"]]; G3 <- dists[["GPD(0.3)"]]; S15 <- dists[["Stable(1.5,0)"]]
  add("Gaussian CVaR, p = 0.95: phi(q)/(1-p)", truth(N, gens$quad, 0.95)$s, dnorm(qnorm(0.95)) / 0.05, 1e-8)
  q3 <- G3$q(0.95)
  add("GPD(0.3) quadratic SQ: (sigma + q)/(1 - xi)", truth(G3, gens$quad, 0.95)$s, (1 + q3) / 0.7, 1e-8)
  add("GPD(0.3) quadratic SQ by tail integration", q3 + G3$tail_int(function(x) x - q3, q3) / 0.05, (1 + q3) / 0.7, 1e-6)
  add("Stable H, alpha = 2: E[X^+] = 1/sqrt(pi)", H_stable(0, 2, 0), 1 / sqrt(pi), 1e-6)
  qs <- S15$q(0.95)
  add("Stable(1.5,0): H = density quadrature", H_stable(qs, 1.5, 0), S15$tail_int(function(x) x - qs, qs), 5e-3)
  add("Stable(1.5,0.5): H = density quadrature", H_stable(1, 1.5, 0.5),
      make_dist("stable", alpha = 1.5, beta = 0.5)$tail_int(function(x) x - 1, 1), 5e-3)
  set.seed(1); x <- rnorm(5000); qn <- gens$quad; qn$name <- "quad_numeric"
  add("Kernel estimator: closed form = quadrature", est_kernel(x, 0.95, gens$quad, 0.1)$est,
      est_kernel(x, 0.95, qn, 0.1)$est, 1e-6)
  for (g in names(gens)) {
    tr <- truth(N, gens[[g]], 0.95)
    add(paste0("Newton gains: recursive variance = sigma^2 [", g, "]"), tr$var_rec_newton, tr$sigma2, 1e-8)
  }
  tr <- truth(N, gens$quad, 0.95)
  add("Recursive bias, fixed h: -(A^-1 beta)_2 = -f(q)/(2(1-p))", -solve(tr$A, tr$beta_rec)[2], -tr$f / 0.1, 1e-8)
  h <- 0.05
  add("Exact fixed point of the recursion (N(0,1), h = 0.05) vs first order",
      tr$theta / sqrt(1 + h^2) - tr$theta, -tr$f / 0.1 * h^2, 3e-3)
  set.seed(2); y <- rexp(20000); ge <- gens$asinh
  add("Empirical asinh SQ, Exp(1), p = 0.5, n = 20000", est_emp_rows(sort_rows(matrix(y, 1)), 0.5, ge)$est,
      ge$ginv(integrate(function(t) asinh(t) * exp(-t), log(2), Inf)$value / 0.5), 0.02)
  do.call(rbind, chk)
}
sc <- selfcheck()
kable(sc, digits = 6, caption = "Preliminary checks of the exact formulas")
if (any(sc$Status != "PASS")) warning("Checks not passed: ", paste(sc$Check[sc$Status != "PASS"], collapse = "; "))
```

```{r truth-table}
    sigma2 = tr$sigma2, `B'` = tr$Bprime,

```

Newton gains (or averaging) are needed to reach the batch variance $\sigma^2$ (Corollary 3.4); with these
gains all estimators of the study share the asymptotic variance $\sigma^2$.

# Main experiment (objectives 1 to 3)

```{r main-engine}
run_block <- function(d, di, b, cfg, gens) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 100003L * di + b)
  B <- cfg$block; n <- cfg$n; P <- cfg$p_levels; grid <- cfg$n_grid
  X <- matrix(d$r(B * n), B, n)
  keys <- as.vector(outer(names(gens), P, paste, sep = "|"))
  res <- setNames(lapply(keys, function(k) list()), keys)
  for (m in grid) {
    Xm <- X[, seq_len(m), drop = FALSE]; Xs <- sort_rows(Xm)
    hm <- (if (cfg$h_scale == "robust") apply(Xm, 1, robust_scale) else rep(1, B)) * m^(-cfg$a_default)
    for (p in P) {
      kq <- ceiling(m * p - 1e-9)
      qh <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) kernel_quantile(Xm[i, ], p, hm[i], start = Xs[i, kq]), numeric(1))
      for (g in names(gens)) {
        gen <- gens[[g]]; key <- paste(g, p, sep = "|")
        e <- est_emp_rows(Xs, p, gen)
        kest <- gen$ginv(vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) est_kernel(Xm[i, ], p, gen, hm[i], qh = qh[i])$T, numeric(1)))
        res[[key]][[col_name("emp", NA, m)]] <- e$est
        res[[key]][[col_name("ker", cfg$a_default, m)]] <- kest
        if (m == n) {
          res[[key]][["se:emp"]] <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) se_batch(Xm[i, ], p, gen, e$q[i], e$est[i]), numeric(1))
          res[[key]][["se:ker"]] <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) se_batch(Xm[i, ], p, gen, qh[i], kest[i]), numeric(1))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  for (g in names(gens)) {
    gen <- gens[[g]]; GX <- gen$g1(X)
    for (p in P) {
      key <- paste(g, p, sep = "|")
      ws <- warm_start_rows(X, p, gen, n0_rule(p))
      rr <- rec_engine(X, GX, p, gen, ws, cfg$a_rec, cfg$a_pr, grid, cfg$h_scale)   # Newton + PR
      for (j in seq_along(rr$n)) for (cc in colnames(rr$T[[j]])) {
        sp <- strsplit(cc, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        res[[key]][[paste(sp[1], sp[2], rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, cc])
      }
      J <- length(rr$n); Tf <- rr$T[[J]]; Qf <- rr$Q[[J]]
      ad <- as.character(cfg$a_default); ar <- as.character(cfg$a_rec_ref)
      for (mm in list(c("rec_ind", "NA", "rec_ind"), c("rec_ker", ad, "rec_ker"), c("rec_pr", ad, "rec_pr"),
                      c("rec_ker", ar, "rec_ker04"), c("rec_pr", ar, "rec_pr04"))) {   # plug-in sigma (efficient gains)
        cc <- paste(mm[1], mm[2], sep = "|")
        res[[key]][[paste0("se:", mm[3])]] <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i)
          se_batch(X[i, ], p, gen, Qf[i, cc], gen$ginv(Tf[i, cc])), numeric(1))
      }
    }
  }
  lapply(res, function(l) do.call(cbind, l))
}

run_main <- function(cfg, dists, gens) {
  nb <- cfg$M %/% cfg$block; out <- list()
  for (di in seq_along(dists)) {
    d <- dists[[di]]
    f <- file.path(cfg$out, sprintf("main3_%s_n%d_B%d.rds", file_id(d$id), cfg$n, cfg$block))
    st <- if (file.exists(f)) readRDS(f) else list(done = integer(0), res = NULL)
    todo <- setdiff(seq_len(nb), st$done)
    if (length(todo)) {
      chunks <- split(todo, ceiling(seq_along(todo) / cfg$cores))
      for (ch in chunks) {
        t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
        rl <- par_map(ch, function(b) run_block(d, di, b, cfg, gens), cfg$cores)
        for (r in rl) st$res <- if (is.null(st$res)) r else Map(rbind, st$res, r)
        st$done <- c(st$done, ch); saveRDS(st, f)
        msg <- sprintf("[%s] %s: blocks %s done (%d/%d), %.0f s", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), d$id,
                       paste(ch, collapse = ","), length(st$done), nb, proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0)
        cat(msg, "\n", file = stderr())                                            # visible during knitting
        cat(msg, "\n", file = file.path(cfg$out, "progress.log"), append = TRUE)
      }
    }
    keep <- seq_len(min(cfg$M, nrow(st$res[[1]])))
    out[[d$id]] <- lapply(st$res, function(Mx) Mx[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  out
}
```

```{r main-run, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_main = TRUE))$run_main)}
t_main <- system.time(MAIN <- run_main(cfg, dists, gens))
message(sprintf("Main experiment: %.1f min", t_main[["elapsed"]] / 60))
```

## Monte Carlo summaries

```{r main-summary, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_main = TRUE))$run_main)}
parse_cols <- function(cn) {
  sp <- strsplit(cn, "|", fixed = TRUE)
  data.frame(col = cn, method = vapply(sp, `[`, "", 1),
             a = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vapply(sp, `[`, "", 2))),
             n = as.integer(vapply(sp, `[`, "", 3)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
ks_stat <- function(z) if (length(z) > 10) unname(suppressWarnings(ks.test(z, "pnorm")$statistic)) else NA_real_

#' Columns of the reference estimators at the final sample size.
ref_cols <- function(cfg) {
  k <- names(meth_lab)
  setNames(vapply(k, function(x) col_name(key_method(x), key_a(x), cfg$n), ""), k)
}
summarise_main <- function(MAIN, cfg) {
  rows <- list(); cov_rows <- list()
  for (dn in names(MAIN)) for (key in names(MAIN[[dn]])) {
    Mx <- MAIN[[dn]][[key]]; g <- sub("\\|.*", "", key); p <- as.numeric(sub(".*\\|", "", key))
    tr <- TR[[paste(dn, g, p, sep = "|")]]; cpop <- pop_scale(dists[[dn]], cfg)
    pc <- parse_cols(colnames(Mx)[!startsWith(colnames(Mx), "se:")])
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(pc))) {
      v <- Mx[, pc$col[j]]; v <- v[is.finite(v)]; e <- v - tr$s
      th <- theory_for(tr, pc$method[j], pc$a[j], pc$n[j], cpop)
      ok_th <- is.finite(th[["sd"]]) && th[["sd"]] > 0
      bth <- if (is.finite(th[["bias"]])) th[["bias"]] else 0
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        dist = dn, gen = g, p = p, regime = tr$regime, method = pc$method[j], a = pc$a[j], n = pc$n[j],
        est_key = ref_key(pc$method[j], pc$a[j]),
        M_ok = length(v), truth = tr$s, bias = mean(e), mcse_bias = sd(e) / sqrt(length(e)), sd = sd(e),
        rmse = sqrt(mean(e^2)), rel_bias = mean(e) / abs(tr$s), rel_rmse = sqrt(mean(e^2)) / abs(tr$s),
        median_abs_err = median(abs(e)), sd_theory = th[["sd"]], bias_theory = th[["bias"]],
        rmse_theory = sqrt(th[["sd"]]^2 + bth^2),
        ks = if (ok_th) ks_stat(e / th[["sd"]]) else NA_real_,
        ks_bias_corrected = if (ok_th) ks_stat((e - bth) / th[["sd"]]) else NA_real_)
    }
    map <- ref_cols(cfg)
    for (m in names(map)) {
      est <- Mx[, map[[m]]]; se <- Mx[, paste0("se:", m)]; ok <- is.finite(est) & is.finite(se)
      cov_rows[[length(cov_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        dist = dn, gen = g, p = p, regime = tr$regime, method = m, M_ok = sum(ok),
        coverage = if (any(ok)) mean(abs(est[ok] - tr$s) <= 1.96 * se[ok]) else NA_real_,
        mean_length = if (any(ok)) mean(2 * 1.96 * se[ok]) else NA_real_,
        sd_mc = if (sum(ok) > 1) sd(est[ok]) else NA_real_, mean_se = if (any(ok)) mean(se[ok]) else NA_real_)
    }
  }
  list(summ = do.call(rbind, rows), cov = do.call(rbind, cov_rows))
}
SUMM <- summarise_main(MAIN, cfg)
summ <- SUMM$summ; covt <- SUMM$cov
summ$method_lab <- factor(unname(meth_lab[summ$est_key]), levels = meth_lab)
covt$method_lab <- factor(meth_lab[covt$method], levels = meth_lab)
summ$gen_lab <- factor(gen_lab[summ$gen], levels = gen_lab); covt$gen_lab <- factor(gen_lab[covt$gen], levels = gen_lab)
write.csv(summ, file.path(cfg$out, "main_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(covt, file.path(cfg$out, "main_coverage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

final_long <- function(MAIN, cfg) {
  map <- ref_cols(cfg)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(MAIN), function(dn) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(MAIN[[dn]]), function(key) {
    Mx <- MAIN[[dn]][[key]]; g <- sub("\\|.*", "", key); p <- as.numeric(sub(".*\\|", "", key))
    tr <- TR[[paste(dn, g, p, sep = "|")]]
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(map), function(m) data.frame(
      dist = dn, gen = gen_lab[[g]], p = p, method = meth_lab[[m]], rep = seq_len(nrow(Mx)),
      est = Mx[, map[[m]]], truth = tr$s)))
  }))))
}
FL <- final_long(MAIN, cfg)
FL$rel_err <- (FL$est - FL$truth) / abs(FL$truth)
FL$method <- factor(FL$method, levels = meth_lab)
FL$dist <- factor(FL$dist, levels = names(dists))
FL$gen <- factor(FL$gen, levels = gen_lab)
## reference estimators only (rec_ker and rec_pr at a_default and a_rec_ref)
ref_methods <- function(d) d %>% filter(!is.na(est_key))
```

## Objective 2c: bias and bandwidth sweep $h_n=n^{-a}$ of the recursive kernel estimator

The recursive indicator estimator does not depend on $a$ and is the **reference** (dashed line).
Signed-bias figure: points = Monte Carlo ($\pm2$ MC standard errors), line = first-order prediction ($a<1/2$).

# Asymptotic normality: Kolmogorov distances up to $n=100\,000$

To evaluate the accuracy of the asymptotic Gaussian approximation, we compute the Kolmogorov distance between the
empirical distribution of $\sqrt{n}\bigl(\widehat\theta_n-\theta\bigr)$ and its Gaussian limit. A decreasing Kolmogorov
distance provides empirical evidence for the validity of the central limit theorem and quantifies the speed at which
the limiting approximation becomes accurate. All estimators are standardised by the same efficient asymptotic standard deviation,
$Z_n=\sqrt n(\widehat{SQ}-SQ)/\sigma$, since the empirical and undersmoothed kernel estimators and the recursive
estimators with Newton gains or Polyak–Ruppert averaging share the variance $\sigma^2$. Only regular scenarios ($\mathrm{Var}(\gamma'(X))<\infty$) are used. One recursive pass of length
$\max n$ gives the recursive estimators at all sample sizes; batch estimators are recomputed on each prefix.

```{r ks-engine}
ks_scenarios <- function() list(
  list(dist = "N(0,1)", gen = "quad"), list(dist = "GPD(0.3)", gen = "quad"),
  list(dist = "N(0,1)", gen = "asinh"), list(dist = "GPD(0.3)", gen = "asinh"),
  list(dist = "GPD(0.8)", gen = "asinh"), list(dist = "Stable(1.5,0)", gen = "asinh"))

run_ks_block <- function(sc, si, b, cfg, B) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 3000017L + 1009L * si + b)
  d <- dists[[sc$dist]]; gen <- gens[[sc$gen]]; nmax <- max(cfg$n_ks)
  X <- matrix(d$r(B * nmax), B, nmax); GX <- gen$g1(X); out <- list()
  for (p in cfg$p_levels) {
    for (m in cfg$n_ks) {
      Xm <- X[, seq_len(m), drop = FALSE]; Xs <- sort_rows(Xm)
      h <- (if (cfg$h_scale == "robust") apply(Xm, 1, robust_scale) else rep(1, B)) * m^(-cfg$a_default)
      kq <- ceiling(m * p - 1e-9)
      out[[paste("emp", p, m, sep = "|")]] <- est_emp_rows(Xs, p, gen)$est
      out[[paste("ker", p, m, sep = "|")]] <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i)
        est_kernel(Xm[i, ], p, gen, h[i], qh = kernel_quantile(Xm[i, ], p, h[i], start = Xs[i, kq]))$est, numeric(1))
    }
    n0 <- min(n0_rule(p), floor(min(cfg$n_ks) / 2))
    ws <- warm_start_rows(X, p, gen, n0)
    rr <- rec_engine(X, GX, p, gen, ws, cfg$a_pr, cfg$a_pr, cfg$n_ks, cfg$h_scale)
    for (j in seq_along(rr$n)) {
      out[[paste("rec_ind", p, rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, "rec_ind|NA"])
      out[[paste("rec_ker", p, rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, paste0("rec_ker|", cfg$a_default)])
      out[[paste("rec_pr", p, rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, paste0("rec_pr|", cfg$a_default)])
      out[[paste("rec_ker04", p, rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, paste0("rec_ker|", cfg$a_rec_ref)])
      out[[paste("rec_pr04", p, rr$n[j], sep = "|")]] <- gen$ginv(rr$T[[j]][, paste0("rec_pr|", cfg$a_rec_ref)])
    }
  }
  out
}
run_ks <- function(cfg) {
  B <- min(100L, cfg$M_ks); nb <- ceiling(cfg$M_ks / B); scs <- ks_scenarios(); res <- list()
  for (si in seq_along(scs)) {
    sc <- scs[[si]]
    f <- file.path(cfg$out, sprintf("ks3_%s_%s_nmax%d_M%d.rds", file_id(sc$dist), sc$gen, max(cfg$n_ks), nb * B))
    if (file.exists(f)) { res[[si]] <- readRDS(f); next }
    rl <- par_map(seq_len(nb), function(b) run_ks_block(sc, si, b, cfg, B), cfg$cores)
    res[[si]] <- list(dist = sc$dist, gen = sc$gen, est = do.call(Map, c(list(f = c), rl)))
    saveRDS(res[[si]], f)
    message("Kolmogorov experiment: ", sc$dist, " / ", sc$gen, " done")
  }
  res
}
```

```{r ks-run, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_ks = TRUE))$run_ks), fig.width = 16, fig.height = 10}

  tr <- TR[[paste(r$dist, r$gen, p, sep = "|")]]

}))))

emit_plot(pl, d, "fig_ks_distance", 16, 10)

## quantities used in the paragraph below

n_last <- max(ks_avg$n)

  if (diff_ek < 0.02) "nearly identical" else "noticeably different", diff_ek, cfg$a_default,
```

## Objective 2d: bandwidth regimes of the batch kernel estimator

$h_n=c\,n^{-a}$; bias $\approx B'h_n^2$, standard deviation $\approx\sigma/\sqrt n$, hence
$\text{bias}/\text{sd}\approx B'\sqrt n\,h_n^2/\sigma$ with $\sqrt n h_n^2=c^2n^{1/2-2a}$:
$a>1/4$ undersmoothing, $a=1/4$ critical (limit $\mathcal N(c^2B',\sigma^2)$), $a<1/4$ oversmoothing.
The black line is the prediction $B'x/\sigma$, a direct test of the corrected constant $B'$.

```{r bw-engine}
run_bw_block <- function(d, di, b, cfg, gens, a_bw, B) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 7000003L + 100003L * di + b)
  n <- cfg$n; X <- matrix(d$r(B * n), B, n); out <- list()
  cs <- if (cfg$h_scale == "robust") apply(X, 1, robust_scale) else rep(1, B)
  for (a in a_bw) for (p in cfg$p_levels) {
    h <- cs * n^(-a)
    qh <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) kernel_quantile(X[i, ], p, h[i]), numeric(1))
    for (g in names(gens)) out[[paste(g, p, a, sep = "|")]] <-
      gens[[g]]$ginv(vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) est_kernel(X[i, ], p, gens[[g]], h[i], qh = qh[i])$T, numeric(1)))
  }
  out
}
run_bw <- function(cfg, dists, gens, a_bw = c(0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5)) {
  B <- min(cfg$block, cfg$M_bw); nb <- ceiling(cfg$M_bw / B); res <- list()
  for (di in seq_along(dists)) {
    d <- dists[[di]]
    f <- file.path(cfg$out, sprintf("bw_%s_n%d_M%d.rds", file_id(d$id), cfg$n, nb * B))
    if (file.exists(f)) { res[[d$id]] <- readRDS(f); next }
    rl <- par_map(seq_len(nb), function(b) run_bw_block(d, di, b, cfg, gens, a_bw, B), cfg$cores)
    res[[d$id]] <- do.call(Map, c(list(f = c), rl)); saveRDS(res[[d$id]], f)
    message("Bandwidth regimes: ", d$id, " done")
  }
  res
}
```

```{r bw-run, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_bw = TRUE))$run_bw), fig.width = 16, fig.height = 12}
BW <- run_bw(cfg, dists, gens)
bw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(BW), function(dn) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(BW[[dn]]), function(k) {
  sp <- strsplit(k, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]; g <- sp[1]; p <- as.numeric(sp[2]); a <- as.numeric(sp[3])
  v <- BW[[dn]][[k]]; v <- v[is.finite(v)]; tr <- TR[[paste(dn, g, p, sep = "|")]]
  cpop <- pop_scale(dists[[dn]], cfg); x <- sqrt(cfg$n) * (cpop * cfg$n^(-a))^2
  data.frame(dist = dn, gen = g, p = p, a = a, regime = tr$regime, M = length(v), x = x,
             bias = mean(v) - tr$s, sd = sd(v), ratio = (mean(v) - tr$s) / sd(v),
             bias_theory = tr$Bprime * (cpop * cfg$n^(-a))^2,
             ratio_theory = if (is.finite(tr$sigma2)) tr$Bprime * x / sqrt(tr$sigma2) else NA_real_,
             regime_h = ifelse(abs(a - 0.25) < 1e-9, "critical (a = 1/4)", ifelse(a > 0.25, "undersmoothing", "oversmoothing")))
}))))
write.csv(bw, file.path(cfg$out, "bandwidth_regimes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
save_latex(bw %>% transmute(Distribution = dist, Generator = gen_lab[gen], p, a, Regime = regime_h, `sqrt(n) h^2` = x,
                            Bias = bias, `B' h^2` = bias_theory, `Bias/SD` = ratio, `Predicted bias/SD` = ratio_theory),
           "bandwidth_regimes", digits = 4,
           caption = "Batch kernel estimator: Monte Carlo bias, theoretical bias B' h_n^2, bias-to-SD ratio and its prediction B' sqrt(n) h_n^2 / sigma.")
for (gname in names(gens)) {

         subtitle = "Dashed: B' sqrt(n) h_n^2 / sigma. GPD at p = 0.25: boundary effect at 0 when h is large.") +
```

## Objective 3: trajectories and streaming cost

```{r traj, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_traj = TRUE))$run_traj), fig.width = 16, fig.height = 16}
trajectories <- function(cfg, n_pts = 100) {
  step <- cfg$n / n_pts; grid <- as.integer(seq(step, cfg$n, by = step)); out <- list()
  for (di in seq_along(dists)) {
    d <- dists[[di]]; set.seed(cfg$seed + 31L * di); x <- d$r(cfg$n); X <- matrix(x, 1)
    for (p in cfg$p_levels) {
      hm <- vapply(grid, function(m) (if (cfg$h_scale == "robust") robust_scale(x[1:m]) else 1) * m^(-cfg$a_default), numeric(1))
      qh <- vapply(seq_along(grid), function(j) kernel_quantile(x[1:grid[j]], p, hm[j]), numeric(1))
      for (g in names(gens)) {
        gen <- gens[[g]]; tv <- TR[[paste(d$id, g, p, sep = "|")]]$s
        ws <- warm_start_rows(X, p, gen, n0_rule(p))
        rr <- rec_engine(X, gen$g1(X), p, gen, ws, cfg$a_pr, cfg$a_pr, grid, cfg$h_scale)
        rec <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(rr$n), function(j) data.frame(
          n = rr$n[j], method = c("rec_ker", "rec_ker04", "rec_pr", "rec_pr04", "rec_ind"), est = gen$ginv(as.numeric(rr$T[[j]][1, ])))))
        bat <- data.frame(n = rep(grid, 2), method = rep(c("emp", "ker"), each = length(grid)),
                          est = c(vapply(grid, function(m) est_emp_rows(sort_rows(X[, 1:m, drop = FALSE]), p, gen)$est, numeric(1)),
                                  vapply(seq_along(grid), function(j) est_kernel(x[1:grid[j]], p, gen, hm[j], qh = qh[j])$est, numeric(1))))
        z <- rbind(rec, bat); z$dist <- d$id; z$gen <- gen$label; z$p <- p; z$truth <- tv
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- z
      }
    }
  }
  z <- do.call(rbind, out)
  z$method <- factor(meth_lab[z$method], levels = meth_lab); z$dist <- factor(z$dist, levels = names(dists))
  z$gen <- factor(z$gen, levels = gen_lab)
  z %>% group_by(p, dist, gen) %>%
    mutate(lo = min(truth[1], quantile(est, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)), hi = max(truth[1], quantile(est, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)),
           est_c = pmin(pmax(est, lo - 0.15 * (hi - lo)), hi + 0.15 * (hi - lo))) %>% ungroup()
}
TRJ <- trajectories(cfg)
for (pp in cfg$p_levels) {
  d <- TRJ %>% filter(p == pp, is.finite(est_c))
  pl <- ggplot(d, aes(n, est_c, colour = method, linetype = method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(data = distinct(d, dist, gen, truth), aes(yintercept = truth), linetype = 2, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_grid(dist ~ gen, scales = "free_y") + scale_colour_manual(values = meth_col) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "22", "solid", "solid", "solid", "42", "42"), meth_lab)) +
    labs(x = "Sample size n", y = "Superquantile estimate", colour = NULL, linetype = NULL,
         title = sprintf("Representative trajectories (p = %.2f)", pp),
         subtitle = "Dashed grey: true value. Curves clipped per panel for readability.") +
    theme_article(14) + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
  emit_plot(pl, d, paste0("fig_trajectories_p_", pfile(pp)), 16, 16)
}
```

```{r stream, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_stream = TRUE))$run_stream), fig.width = 14, fig.height = 7}
stream_cost <- function(d, gen, p, N, every, cfg) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 999L); x <- d$r(N); r <- 1 - p; n0 <- n0_rule(p)
  ws <- warm_start_rows(matrix(x, 1), p, gen, n0); Q <- ws$Q; T <- ws$T; gq <- ws$gq
  cps <- seq(every, N, by = every); cps <- cps[cps > n0]
  t_rec <- t_emp <- t_ker <- numeric(length(cps)); tcum <- 0; i <- n0
  timeit <- function(f, reps = 3) { t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]; for (k in 1:reps) f(); (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0) / reps }
  for (j in seq_along(cps)) {
    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    while (i < cps[j]) {
      i <- i + 1L; xi <- x[i]
      W <- pnorm((Q - xi) / (i^(-cfg$a_default)))
      T <- T - (T - gen$g1(xi) * (1 - W) / r - gen$g1(Q) * (W - p) / r) / i   # Newton gains
      Q <- Q - gq * (W - p) / i
    }
    tcum <- tcum + proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0; t_rec[j] <- tcum
    m <- cps[j]; xm <- x[1:m]
    t_emp[j] <- timeit(function() est_emp_rows(sort_rows(matrix(xm, 1)), p, gen))
    t_ker[j] <- timeit(function() est_kernel(xm, p, gen, m^(-cfg$a_default)))
  }
  data.frame(n = cps, Recursive = t_rec, Empirical = cumsum(t_emp), Kernel = cumsum(t_ker),
             `Memory, recursive (bytes)` = as.numeric(object.size(c(Q, T, gq, i))), `Memory, batch (bytes)` = 8 * cps,
             check.names = FALSE)
}
every <- max(50L, cfg$n %/% 100L)
SC <- stream_cost(dists[["GPD(0.3)"]], gens$asinh, 0.95, cfg$n, every, cfg)
write.csv(SC, file.path(cfg$out, "streaming_cost.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
scl <- SC %>% select(n, Recursive, Empirical, Kernel) %>% pivot_longer(-n, names_to = "Method", values_to = "time") %>% filter(time > 0)
pl <- ggplot(scl, aes(n, time, colour = Method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Number of observations processed (log scale)", y = "Cumulative CPU time (s, log scale)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Cost of keeping the estimate up to date in a data stream (GPD(0.3), asinh, p = 0.95)",
       subtitle = sprintf("Batch estimators recomputed every %d observations; recursive estimator updated at each observation", every)) +
  theme_article(14)
emit_plot(pl, scl, "fig_streaming_cost", 14, 7)
save_latex(tail(SC, 1), "streaming_cost", digits = 4, caption = "Cumulative CPU time (s) and memory (bytes) at the last checkpoint.")
```

# Objective 4: Bregman superquantiles for parameter estimation

## Generalized Pareto distribution under contamination

$X\sim(1-\varepsilon)F+\varepsilon G$, $F=$ GPD$(\xi,1)$, $G=Q_F(0.999)\times$Pareto$(1.05)$ (extreme outliers),
$\varepsilon\in\{0,0.05\}$, $\xi\in\{0.1,0.5\}$. Estimators: maximum likelihood (MLE), Hill ($\xi$ only),
score-quantile (Section 5.1, **identified only for $p<p^*(\xi)\approx0.80$–$0.86$**), and quantile/superquantile matching
with the quadratic generator ("CVaR matching") and with `asinh` ("Bregman matching"), the superquantile being estimated
by the empirical, kernel or recursive estimator.

```{r gpd-defs}
.na2 <- c(xi = NA_real_, sigma = NA_real_)
est_gpd_mle <- function(x) {
  nll <- function(par) { xi <- par[1]; sg <- exp(par[2]); if (abs(xi) < 1e-6) xi <- 1e-6
    z <- 1 + xi * x / sg; if (any(z <= 0)) return(1e10); length(x) * log(sg) + (1 / xi + 1) * sum(log(z)) }
  best <- NULL
  for (s0 in list(c(0.2, log(mean(x) * 0.8)), c(0.5, log(median(x))), c(0.05, log(mean(x))))) {
    fit <- tryCatch(optim(s0, nll, control = list(maxit = 3000, reltol = 1e-11)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit) && fit$value < 1e9 && (is.null(best) || fit$value < best$value)) best <- fit
  }
  if (is.null(best)) .na2 else c(xi = best$par[1], sigma = exp(best$par[2]))
}
est_gpd_hill <- function(x, k = floor(sqrt(length(x)))) {
  xs <- sort(x[x > 0], decreasing = TRUE); c(xi = mean(log(xs[1:k])) - log(xs[k + 1]), sigma = NA_real_)
}
h_fun <- function(y, xi) -log(y) / xi - (1 + xi) / xi^2 * (1 - y^xi)
p_star <- function(xi) { us <- (1 + xi)^(-1 / xi); 1 - uniroot(function(u) h_fun(u, xi), c(1e-300, us), tol = 1e-14)$root }
#' Largest xi such that p < p*(xi) (p* is decreasing in xi): upper end of the root search of the score-quantile equation.
xi_max_for <- function(p) if (p_star(0.99) > p) 0.99 else uniroot(function(xi) p_star(xi) - p, c(0.02, 0.99), tol = 1e-10)$root
est_gpd_scorequant <- function(x, p) {
  r <- 1 - p; qh <- as.numeric(quantile(x, p, type = 1))
  if (p >= p_star(0.02)) return(.na2)                 # not identified for any xi in the search range
  zp <- function(xi) {
    y1 <- tryCatch(uniroot(function(y) h_fun(y, xi) - h_fun(y + p, xi), c(1e-12, r - 1e-12), tol = 1e-13)$root,
                   error = function(e) NA_real_)
    h_fun(y1, xi)
  }
  eq <- function(xi) { sg <- xi * qh / (r^(-xi) - 1)
    t2 <- log1p(xi * x / sg) / xi^2 - (1 + xi) * x / (sg * xi + xi^2 * x)
    as.numeric(quantile(t2, p, type = 1)) - zp(xi) }
  xi <- tryCatch(uniroot(eq, c(0.02, xi_max_for(p) - 1e-6), tol = 1e-8)$root, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (!is.finite(xi) || p >= p_star(xi)) return(.na2)
  c(xi = xi, sigma = xi * qh / (r^(-xi) - 1))
}
gpd_model_sq <- function(xi, sg, p, gen) {
  r <- 1 - p; q <- sg / xi * (r^(-xi) - 1); sq <- sg + xi * q
  if (gen$name == "quad") return(c(q = q, s = (sg + q) / (1 - xi)))
  y <- q + sq / xi * (exp(xi * .GLag$x) - 1)
  c(q = q, s = gen$ginv(sum(.GLag$w * gen$g1(y))))
}
est_gpd_match <- function(qh, sh, p, gen) {
  r <- 1 - p
  if (!is.finite(qh) || !is.finite(sh) || qh <= 0) return(.na2)
  sig_of <- function(xi) xi * qh / (r^(-xi) - 1)
  f <- function(xi) gpd_model_sq(xi, sig_of(xi), p, gen)[["s"]] - sh
  hi <- if (gen$name == "quad") 0.98 else 1.5
  xi <- tryCatch(uniroot(f, c(0.01, hi), tol = 1e-9)$root, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (!is.finite(xi)) .na2 else c(xi = xi, sigma = sig_of(xi))
}
run_gpd_block <- function(xi0, eps, b, cfg, B) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 5000011L + round(1e4 * xi0) * 101L + round(100 * eps) * 7L + b)
  F <- make_dist("gpd", xi = xi0); n <- cfg$n_param
  X <- matrix(F$r(B * n), B, n)
  if (eps > 0) { m <- runif(B * n) < eps; X[m] <- F$q(0.999) * runif(sum(m))^(-1 / 1.05) }
  rows <- list()
  add <- function(method, sqe, p, th, i) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
    xi0 = xi0, eps = eps, rep = (b - 1) * B + i, method = method, sq_est = sqe, p = p,
    xi_hat = unname(th[1]), sigma_hat = unname(th[2]))
  for (i in seq_len(B)) { add("MLE", NA, NA, est_gpd_mle(X[i, ]), i); add("Hill", NA, NA, est_gpd_hill(X[i, ]), i) }
  Xs <- sort_rows(X)
  for (p in cfg$p_levels) {
    for (i in seq_len(B)) add("Score-quantile", NA, p, est_gpd_scorequant(X[i, ], p), i)
    h <- n^(-cfg$a_default)
    qh <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(i) kernel_quantile(X[i, ], p, h), numeric(1))
    for (g in names(gens)) {
      gen <- gens[[g]]; lab <- if (g == "quad") "CVaR matching" else "Bregman (asinh) matching"
      e <- est_emp_rows(Xs, p, gen)
      k <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(i) est_kernel(X[i, ], p, gen, h, qh = qh[i]))
      ws <- warm_start_rows(X, p, gen, n0_rule(p))
      rr <- rec_engine(X, gen$g1(X), p, gen, ws, cfg$a_default, numeric(0), n, cfg$h_scale, ind = FALSE)
      cc <- paste0("rec_ker|", cfg$a_default)
      for (i in seq_len(B)) {
        add(lab, "empirical", p, est_gpd_match(e$q[i], e$est[i], p, gen), i)
        add(lab, "kernel", p, est_gpd_match(k[[i]]$q, k[[i]]$est, p, gen), i)
        add(lab, "recursive", p, est_gpd_match(rr$Q[[1]][i, cc], gen$ginv(rr$T[[1]][i, cc]), p, gen), i)
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
run_gpd <- function(cfg, xis = c(0.1, 0.5), epss = c(0, 0.05)) {
  B <- min(100L, cfg$M_param); nb <- ceiling(cfg$M_param / B)
  f <- file.path(cfg$out, sprintf("gpd_params_n%d_M%d.rds", cfg$n_param, nb * B))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  jobs <- expand.grid(xi0 = xis, eps = epss, b = seq_len(nb))
  rl <- par_map(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(j) run_gpd_block(jobs$xi0[j], jobs$eps[j], jobs$b[j], cfg, B), cfg$cores)
  res <- do.call(rbind, rl); saveRDS(res, f); res
}
```

```{r gpd-run, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_gpd = TRUE))$run_gpd), fig.width = 16, fig.height = 11}

kable(data.frame(xi = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8), `p*(xi)` = vapply(c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8), p_star, 1), check.names = FALSE),
      digits = 3, caption = "Identifiability threshold p*(xi) of the score-quantile estimator")
gsum <- GP %>% mutate(sq_est = ifelse(is.na(sq_est), "-", sq_est)) %>%
  group_by(xi0, eps, method, sq_est, p) %>%

            `Bias xi` = mean(xi_hat - xi0, na.rm = TRUE), `RMSE xi` = sqrt(mean((xi_hat - xi0)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
            `Bias sigma` = mean(sigma_hat - 1, na.rm = TRUE), `RMSE sigma` = sqrt(mean((sigma_hat - 1)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(xi0, eps, p, method, sq_est) %>%

gp <- GP %>% filter(is.na(sq_est) | sq_est == "empirical", is.finite(xi_hat)) %>%
```

### Contamination study at an identified level (Table "tab:contam" of the article)

$n=200$, $p=0.8$ (identified for $\xi\in\{0.1,0.5\}$: $p^*(0.1)\approx0.856$, $p^*(0.5)\approx0.826$; and
$\varepsilon=0.05<1-p$), contamination $(1-\varepsilon)F+\varepsilon\delta_{20\sigma}$, $M=1000$ replications. The matching
estimators use the empirical quantile and superquantile. Failures (no root in the admissible range) are reported;
bias and RMSE are computed over the other samples.

```{r gpd-contam-table, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_gpd = TRUE))$run_gpd)}
run_contam <- function(xi0, eps, n = 200, p = 0.8, M = 1000) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 77L + round(1e4 * xi0) + round(100 * eps))
  rows <- vector("list", M)
  for (m in seq_len(M)) {
    x <- (runif(n)^(-xi0) - 1) / xi0
    if (eps > 0) x[runif(n) < eps] <- 20
    xs <- matrix(sort(x), 1); ea <- est_emp_rows(xs, p, gens$asinh); eq <- est_emp_rows(xs, p, gens$quad)
    th <- rbind(`Bregman (asinh) matching` = est_gpd_match(ea$q, ea$est, p, gens$asinh),
                `CVaR matching` = est_gpd_match(eq$q, eq$est, p, gens$quad),
                Hill = est_gpd_hill(x), MLE = est_gpd_mle(x), `Score-quantile` = est_gpd_scorequant(x, p))
    rows[[m]] <- data.frame(method = rownames(th), xi_hat = th[, 1], sigma_hat = th[, 2], row.names = NULL)
  }
  d <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  d %>% group_by(method) %>%
    summarise(Failure = mean(!is.finite(xi_hat)), `Bias xi` = mean(xi_hat - xi0, na.rm = TRUE),
              `RMSE xi` = sqrt(mean((xi_hat - xi0)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
              `RMSE sigma` = if (all(is.na(sigma_hat))) NA_real_ else sqrt(mean((sigma_hat - 1)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
              .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(epsilon = eps, xi = xi0, .before = 1)
}
CONT <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0, 0.05), function(e) do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0.1, 0.5), function(x0) run_contam(x0, e)))))
write.csv(CONT, file.path(cfg$out, "gpd_contamination_p08.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
save_latex(CONT, "tab_contam", digits = 3,
  caption = "Estimation of (xi, sigma) under contamination at 20 sigma, n = 200, p = 0.8, M = 1000.")
```


## Stable distributions: exact relation of Theorem 6.1

A complete study (five superquantile estimators, five optimizers, ECF benchmark and ECF diagnostics) is given in the
companion notebook `stable_parameters_superquantiles.Rmd`. Here $\theta=(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\zeta)$ is estimated with
the quadratic generator (exact relation $SQ_p-Q_p=H(Q_p;\theta)/(1-p)$) on both tails.

```{r stable-defs}
stable_obj <- function(par, st) {
  al <- par[1]; be <- par[2]; ga <- par[3]; ze <- par[4]
  if (al <= 1.02 || al > 2 || abs(be) > 0.99 || ga <= 0) return(1e10)
  r1 <- (st$S_up - st$Q_up - H_stable(st$Q_up, al, be, ga, ze) / (1 - st$p)) / (1 + abs(st$S_up))
  r2 <- (st$S_lo - st$Q_lo - H_stable(st$Q_lo, al, -be, ga, -ze) / (1 - st$p)) / (1 + abs(st$S_lo))
  v <- sum(r1^2) + sum(r2^2); if (is.finite(v)) v else 1e10
}
fit_stable_H <- function(st) {
  lo <- c(1.05, -0.95, 0.05, -5); hi <- c(2, 0.95, 10, 5)
  S <- expand.grid(a = c(1.3, 1.6, 1.9), b = c(-0.4, 0, 0.4), g = c(0.5, 1), z = 0)
  v0 <- apply(S, 1, stable_obj, st = st); best <- NULL
  for (k in order(v0)[1:3]) {
    o <- tryCatch(nlminb(as.numeric(S[k, ]), stable_obj, st = st, lower = lo, upper = hi, control = list(iter.max = 300)),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(o) && (is.null(best) || o$objective < best$objective)) best <- o
  }
  if (is.null(best)) rep(NA_real_, 4) else best$par
}
run_stable_block <- function(al0, be0, b, cfg, B) {
  set.seed(cfg$seed + 9000001L + round(100 * al0) * 131L + round(100 * be0) * 17L + b)
  n <- cfg$n_stable; P <- cfg$p_levels; gen <- gens$quad
  X <- matrix(stabledist::rstable(B * n, alpha = al0, beta = be0, gamma = 1, delta = 0, pm = 0), B, n)
  med <- apply(X, 1, median); sc <- apply(X, 1, robust_scale); Z <- (X - med) / sc
  tails <- list(up = Z, lo = -Z); stats <- list()
  for (tl in names(tails)) {
    Y <- tails[[tl]]; Ys <- sort_rows(Y)
    for (p in P) {
      e <- est_emp_rows(Ys, p, gen); h <- n^(-cfg$a_default)
      k <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(i) est_kernel(Y[i, ], p, gen, h))
      ws <- warm_start_rows(Y, p, gen, n0_rule(p))
      rr <- rec_engine(Y, Y, p, gen, ws, cfg$a_default, numeric(0), n, cfg$h_scale)
      ck <- paste0("rec_ker|", cfg$a_default)
      stats[[paste(tl, p)]] <- list(
        empirical = cbind(e$q, e$est), kernel = cbind(vapply(k, `[[`, 1, "q"), vapply(k, `[[`, 1, "est")),
        recursive_kernel = cbind(rr$Q[[1]][, ck], rr$T[[1]][, ck]),
        recursive_indicator = cbind(rr$Q[[1]][, "rec_ind|NA"], rr$T[[1]][, "rec_ind|NA"]))
    }
  }
  rows <- list()
  for (est in c("empirical", "kernel", "recursive_indicator", "recursive_kernel")) for (i in seq_len(B)) {
    g <- function(tl) t(vapply(P, function(p) stats[[paste(tl, p)]][[est]][i, ], numeric(2)))
    U <- g("up"); L <- g("lo")
    th <- fit_stable_H(list(p = P, Q_up = U[, 1], S_up = U[, 2], Q_lo = L[, 1], S_lo = L[, 2]))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(alpha0 = al0, beta0 = be0, rep = (b - 1) * B + i, estimator = est,
      alpha = th[1], beta = th[2], gamma = sc[i] * th[3], zeta = med[i] + sc[i] * th[4])
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
run_stable <- function(cfg) {
  B <- min(50L, cfg$M_stable); nb <- ceiling(cfg$M_stable / B)
  f <- file.path(cfg$out, sprintf("stable_params_n%d_M%d.rds", cfg$n_stable, nb * B))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  jobs <- expand.grid(al0 = cfg$stable_alpha, be0 = cfg$stable_beta, b = seq_len(nb))
  rl <- par_map(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(j) run_stable_block(jobs$al0[j], jobs$be0[j], jobs$b[j], cfg, B), cfg$cores)
  res <- do.call(rbind, rl); saveRDS(res, f); res
}
```

```{r stable-run, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_stable = TRUE))$run_stable), fig.width = 16, fig.height = 9}
ST <- run_stable(cfg)
ssum <- ST %>% group_by(alpha0, beta0, estimator) %>%
  summarise(M = n(), `Failure rate` = mean(!is.finite(alpha)),
            `Bias alpha` = mean(alpha - alpha0, na.rm = TRUE), `RMSE alpha` = sqrt(mean((alpha - alpha0)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
            `Bias beta` = mean(beta - beta0, na.rm = TRUE), `RMSE beta` = sqrt(mean((beta - beta0)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
            `RMSE log gamma` = sqrt(mean(log(gamma)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), `RMSE zeta` = sqrt(mean(zeta^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% rename(alpha = alpha0, beta = beta0, `Superquantile estimator` = estimator)
write.csv(ssum, file.path(cfg$out, "stable_params_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
save_latex(ssum, "stable_parameters", digits = 4,
  caption = sprintf("Estimation of the stable parameters from superquantile estimating equations (Theorem 6.1, quadratic generator, both tails), n = %d.", cfg$n_stable))
sl <- ST %>% filter(is.finite(alpha)) %>%
  transmute(setting = sprintf("alpha = %.2f, beta = %.2f", alpha0, beta0), estimator,
            `alpha-hat - alpha` = alpha - alpha0, `beta-hat - beta` = beta - beta0) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`alpha-hat - alpha`, `beta-hat - beta`), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "error")
pl <- ggplot(sl, aes(estimator, error, fill = estimator)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4) + facet_grid(parameter ~ setting, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimation error", fill = NULL,
       title = "Stable parameters from superquantile estimating equations (Theorem 6.1)") +
  theme_article(13) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
emit_plot(pl, sl, "fig_stable_params", 16, 9)
```

```{r synthesis, eval = isTRUE(get0("params", ifnotfound = list(run_main = TRUE))$run_main)}
best <- tab1 %>% group_by(Distribution, Generator, p, Regime) %>%
  summarise(`Best (rel. RMSE)` = as.character(Method[which.min(`Rel. RMSE`)]), `Min. rel. RMSE` = min(`Rel. RMSE`),
            `Worst (rel. RMSE)` = as.character(Method[which.max(`Rel. RMSE`)]), `Max. rel. RMSE` = max(`Rel. RMSE`),
            .groups = "drop")
save_latex(best, "best_worst", digits = 4, caption = "Best and worst estimator (relative RMSE) in each scenario, final n.")
```
